summary.text: Johnnie Johnson is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Justine Sandoval.
He was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2022 and 2024, losing both times to incumbent Alex Valdez.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Johnnie Johnson said he was born in Denver, comes from a family of eight, and lost his sight as a child after a reaction to a medication.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Colorado House of Representatives District 5 in 2022 and 2024, and Alex Valdez won the general election both years.

In that 2022 survey, Johnson listed lowering taxes and gas prices, reducing regulations on small businesses, and making Denver Public Schools more transparent and accountable to parents as key messages.
He also said he supports policies in which funding follows the student and teachers are paid based on merit.
